item.title: Re: Nobody is Bored. (and for some reason a Hive)
item.content:encoded:
First of all a big thank you also to you for taking the time and effort to give me feedback.

+ Nobody here
- Nobody still here

I believe 'gestalts' would be the correct word here?

I wanted to make a pun, as Gestalten in German can also mean "suspicious figures" in certain contexts.
As an example:

German – Einige dubiose Gestalten schlichen um das Haus herum.
English – Some dubious crooks crept around the house.

I find this funny in the context of Nobody, because Nobody is exactly the type of person who is up to something at night and in the fog.

If they're physically separated, why are they all writing on the same page?
Like it'd make sense for a few of them to get together and write on the same page but there's like…20? of them?

I had planned to make it no more than 7, but when I counted, I came up with 13 or so. I'm going to change that.

I'm a little torn on this as a whole

I see what you mean, this is also the reason why I so urgently request feedback.

If this article survives, I will certainly write a serious tale where I develop the idea of a "Nobody gang". Just the idea that they keep their personalities after the "Noodle Incident" and the whole group tries to get along with each other is very entertaining for me.

item.title: Re: Nobody is Bored. (and for some reason a Hive)
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

I want to give thisthat one a fat kick in the arse

'fat' is…a strange modifier for 'kick' in english; I'd probably change it to either 'big' or just…leave it unmodified? Or change it to 'I want to kick that ones ass' so it's more of a general 'beat them up' vibe

Way too many Gestalten

I believe 'gestalts' would be the correct word here?

You mean mentally, physically we are still separated.

If they're physically separated, why are they all writing on the same page?

Like it'd make sense for a few of them to get together and write on the same page but there's like…20? of them?

I'm a little torn on this as a whole; there's a lot of charm to it but it also kinda just feels like some low effort shitposts being thrown together to make an article; and part of me kinda wishes it did more with the concept of 'what if nobody was a hivemind' than this, y'know? Like if they started off shitposting and having fun and then gradually they all realised that this was a mistake and the arc shifted towards them trying to fix it; or perhaps if they just like…started to take it more seriously or something? Which like, the second page starts on but it feels like it might need to go further?

Then again, there's a part of me that sort of likes the idea of this being a like…collaborative log where folk can write little things from the perspective of being a nobody; though it feels like it'd quickly turn to a big shitposting spree and crash and burn if that happened so maybe not.

huh. See I thought the bolded text was a different nobody. So what I was suggesting was:

Booooh

I say cut the h. The joke here is that it's both a "booo, this joke sucks" and the boo of a ghost. I've never seen either of those spelt with a h at the end, which makes it harder to piece the joke together quickly I think. (Another weird nitpick)

I'm not a loser.
I'm Nobody!

I say change to:

I'm not a loser,
I'm Nobody!

Seeing it on the page, I think it works better as one sentence rather than two.

A reference to the man in the white suit could be fun. Something like "Has anyone seen White Suit lately?"

There needs to be a doodle somewhere. No messy notebook is complete without a doodle.

aaaaaaah… more work…
I will try to add one after I have finished the article. ^v^

Hope this helps. And as I said, I think this would be totally ready to post if it was just the first page. It's just too perfect.

I'm still waiting for the people I sent a private message to, but thanks, it was actually helpful.

1. In case this is confusing: My user name means "One of Raven"
P. S. I only now realize that this sounds like a hive mind.

item.title: Re: Nobody is Bored. (and for some reason a Hive)
item.content:encoded:
Heyo, it's YellowISlol from "The Furretsidence", and ima be dropping a crit today!

The Crit!
I mean, what did you expect, legos?

Okay, let's start with what you did right: Well, your formatting on it was done really well. I can tell you were going for a sort of a theme that happens within a classroom. I also enjoyed the different fonts, it helped break it down for the eyes, as well as add depth. The colors had the same effect.

Now, let's look at what needs improvement: I mean, theres nothing that invokes humor in me. It's just a bunch of one-offs that would likely take place within a class. I didn't find myself enjoying this read, as it didn't have any laugh effect. Beyond that, the little extra things in the corner only made my eyes feel off. I feel like this would be better if there was something that was humorous at all. Add something relatable, that will make others laugh.

Beyond that, a joke article still needs to be related to the foundation. A note at the top or the bottom would help. Specifically, a note from the foundation about the object. A good example of what I mean can be found on the tale Sunfire (scroll to the bottom of the tale). However, I am not versed in canons at all, and if thats specifically because of the canon, you may ignore this line.

Finally, let's look at what simply needs change: Well, the light blue font is hardly visible here. You can hardly see it. The really cursive font on the third line of cursive doesn't show well, maybe use a different font of cursive for some readers.

Anyways, hope this is helpful!

~Yellow

Well, I tried to make a joke GoI format, more because the Nobody's format is just notepaper and I'm sure we've all had the phase where we've filled a page with weird stuff when we were bored.
Imagine a group of Nobody's bored. The following is what I imagine would happen:

Nobody is bored

From my point of view, it is still a bit too flat and "LOL", but I can imagine that it has potential. If not, I only had 10 minutes to write it. And it is a draft of 115 words.

What do you think?
